paraphrase: Īśāna: in the Kali age japa and worship are to be done in the paśu disposition by brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras and mixed castes; the divya and vīra dispositions do not exist in the Kali age; worship three times a day with bathing, pure food and no meat; a śūdra must not drink intoxicants; or, in brief, the wise one should always practise mentally, remembering the mantra alone, pure or impure, walking, standing or sleeping, for in the Kali age there is no (true) puraścaraṇa, since people are afflicted by hunger and sleep.

paraphrase: Worship of the Śiva-liṅga is allowed to śūdras in the Kali age; worship should be hidden and more hidden, for open worship destroys perfection; inwardly Śāktas, outwardly Śaivas, in the assembly Vaiṣṇavas, the Kaulas wander the earth in many forms.
